features: Take instax credit card sized instant images with the added ability to view, edit and sound images before printing.
2.7 inch LCD display on the back, prints in just 12 seconds, unique, fun, free LiPlay+ app available
Internal image memory and micro SD card slot
Dual cameras, main camera and wide-angle selfie camera, pair with smartphone via Bluetooth
Self-timer from 2 to 10 seconds, micro SD card slot, USB Type-C charging cable, 318 dpi print resolution
description: As a hybrid instant camera and smartphone printer, you can click, print, reprint, store, transfer, and play with photos to your heart’s content. There's also an app to support more functions like filters and frames, direct print, and remote shooting. And, with the Record Sound feature, it's the only camera that captures the sounds of the moment. The world of instant photography just got limitless!
